description_en: Modifies the task information in the task center
description_zh: 任务操作，修改任务中心的任务信息
kebab_example:
aliyun dds modify-task-info --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --task-id t-83br18hlpdrw3uxxxx --step-name 'exec_task
' --task-action modifySwitchTime --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyTaskInfo

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The task ID. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can specify up to 10 IDs
parameters.help_zh: 任务id，多个英文逗号分隔，最多支持10个
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the step visible to the current user
parameters.help_zh: 当前用户可见的步骤名
parameters.name: step_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the operation. The value is the action name corresponding to the status in the actionInfo obtained from the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2639186.html operation.

Valid values: retry, cancel, and modifySwitchTime
parameters.help_zh:
操作名，值为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2639186.html得到的actionInfo内相应状态对应的操作action名称。

已知允许值：retry、cancel、modifySwitchTime
parameters.name: task_action

parameters.help_en:
The parameters related to the action. These parameters can be extended based on business requirements. Different values must be passed for different taskAction names.

When TaskAction is set to modifySwitchTime, this parameter is required. It must be a JSON string that contains the recoverMode key. Valid values for recoverMode: immediate, maintainTime, and timePoint
parameters.help_zh:
动作相关的参数，根据业务需要扩展，不同的taskAction名需传不同的值。

当 TaskAction 为 modifySwitchTime 时，本参数必填，须为 JSON 字符串且包含 recoverMode 键，允许值为 immediate、maintainTime、timePoint
parameters.name: action_params

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code for the failure. This is the same as the API error code
ErrorCode.description_zh: 失败错误码，同接口错误码

ErrorTaskId.description_en: The ID of the failed task. The ID is returned when a failure occurs
ErrorTaskId.description_zh: 失败的任务ID，遇到一个失败即返回
